question: Does P14's genuine reward-trained action-selection beat the much stronger preexisting fully supervised P11 two-step conventional GRU planner when the forced probes, factual observations, action choices, world noise, evaluation horizon and source are identical?
null: P14 fails robust >=0.05 mean factual reward superiority in all 3 paired initializations on each delayed and changing dynamics and/or fails to preserve familiar prior planner competence within 0.02.

training_models: original P14 causal actor reward-to-go REINFORCE
original P11 conventional trained GRU plus model-based two-step plan
original P11 temporal-credit structured model plus same two-step plan
design.P14_unchanged_training: 96 actual REINFORCE updates per model, each 12 actual factual-action worlds of 32 decisions, original P14 source untouched
design.P11_unchanged_training: 1200 AdamW factual targets per model, original 6000 supervised FIT/1920 validation, existing P11 source untouched
design.acceptance: P14 exceeds existing P11 strongest GRU two-step by >=0.05 separately across ALL three paired init seeds in delay2, delay3 and changing_delay, and does not lose >.02 on instant and lagged; also beats reward-broken causal actor by >=.05
design.negative_controls: original P14 corrupted rewards, exact P11 GRU with greedy action policy, original P11 structured two-step, P13 passive online and random; no-action sham action invariant
design.actual_cost_metrics: each original model fit wall plus per-policy evaluation action wall and process-level wall, parameter counts and gradient steps; FLOPs not independently matched
